name: Clownfish
habitat: Tropical coral reefs and sea anemones
funFact: Clownfish are immune to the stinging tentacles of sea anemones.
description: Clownfish are vibrant orange fish with white bands that live symbiotically among sea anemone tentacles. They gain protection from predators while providing the anemone with food scraps and increased water circulation.

name: Blue Tang
funFact: Blue tangs can make themselves nearly invisible at night by changing color.
description: The blue tang is a striking royal blue fish with a bright yellow tail and black markings. Found throughout the Indo-Pacific, it feeds primarily on algae and plays an important role in keeping coral reefs healthy.

name: Mandarinfish
funFact: Mandarinfish are one of only two vertebrates known to produce blue pigment.
description: The mandarinfish is a small, incredibly colorful reef fish with vivid blue, orange, and green patterns. It produces a toxic mucus coating that deters predators and gives it a distinctive smell.

name: Sixbar Wrasse
funFact: Sixbar wrasses can change sex from female to male during their lifetime.
description: The sixbar wrasse is a slender reef fish with distinctive dark vertical bars across its body. Found throughout the Indo-Pacific, it feeds on small crustaceans and fish.

name: Yellowtail Coris
funFact: Juvenile yellowtail coris look completely different from adults with orange and white spotting.
description: The yellowtail coris is a colorful wrasse found in coral reefs across the Indo-Pacific. Adults have a green body with yellow tail and red spots, while juveniles are orange.

name: Bicolor Angelfish
funFact: Bicolor angelfish can make loud popping sounds for communication.
description: The bicolor angelfish features a striking split coloration of dark blue-black on the front half and bright yellow on the rear half. Found in Caribbean reefs, it feeds on algae.

name: Flame Angelfish
funFact: Flame angelfish can become aggressive when kept in small aquariums.
description: The flame angelfish is a brilliant orange-red fish with black vertical bars native to the Pacific. It is one of the most popular marine aquarium fish.

name: Queen Angelfish
funFact: Queen angelfish get their name from a dark blue ring on their forehead resembling a crown.
description: The queen angelfish is a large, stunningly colorful reef fish with blue, yellow, and green hues. Found throughout the tropical western Atlantic, it feeds primarily on sponges.

name: French Angelfish
funFact: French angelfish are often seen in monogamous pairs and travel together for life.
description: The French angelfish is a striking black fish with bright yellow-edged scales found in Caribbean reefs. Young individuals are bright yellow but darken as adults.

name: Regal Tang
funFact: Regal tangs have a retractable spine near their tail that can inflict painful wounds.
description: The regal tang, also known as the palette surgeonfish, is a bright blue fish with a yellow tail and black markings. Found across the Indo-Pacific.

name: Sohal Surgeonfish
funFact: Sohal surgeonfish are extremely territorial and will attack divers who enter their space.
description: The sohal surgeonfish is a large, gray-blue reef fish with horizontal stripes and sharp scalpel-like spines on its tail. Native to the Red Sea and Persian Gulf.

name: Moorish Idol
funFact: Moorish idols are notoriously difficult to keep in captivity and rarely survive long in aquariums.
description: The Moorish idol is one of the most recognizable reef fish with its dramatic black, white, and yellow coloration and a long flowing dorsal fin filament.

name: Royal Gramma
funFact: Royal grammas often hang upside down under rock ledges.
description: The royal gramma, or fairy basslet, has a stunning two-tone coloration with bright purple on the front half and yellow on the rear half. Found in Caribbean caves.

name: Longnose Butterflyfish
funFact: The longnose butterflyfish uses its elongated snout to reach into coral crevices for food.
description: The longnose butterflyfish is a slender reef fish with a distinctive elongated snout and yellow body with a dark eye band.

name: Copperband Butterflyfish
funFact: Copperband butterflyfish have a false eye spot near their tail to confuse predators.
description: The copperband butterflyfish has a striking pattern of vertical orange bands with black edges on a silver-white body.

name: Foureye Butterflyfish
funFact: Foureye butterflyfish have large eye spots that make predators think their tail is their head.
description: The foureye butterflyfish gets its name from the prominent black eye spot on each side near its tail, confusing predators.

name: Bluegill
funFact: Male bluegills build circular nests in shallow water and guard the eggs fiercely.
description: The bluegill is a freshwater sunfish native to eastern North America. It has an olive-green body with a distinctive dark spot on the ear flap.

name: Largemouth Bass
funFact: Largemouth bass can open their mouths wide enough to gulp down prey nearly half their size.
description: The largemouth bass is the largest of the black basses and the most popular freshwater game fish in North America.

name: Smallmouth Bass
funFact: Smallmouth bass are known for their fighting ability and are called brownies or bronzebacks.
description: The smallmouth bass is a freshwater fish prized by anglers for its aggressive fighting style.

name: Rainbow Trout
funFact: Rainbow trout can change color intensity based on their environment and mood.
description: The rainbow trout is a coldwater fish with an olive-green body and a distinctive pinkish-red stripe along its side.

name: Brook Trout
funFact: Brook trout are the only trout native to much of eastern North America.
description: The brook trout, also called speckled trout, has a dark green body with light spots and red spots with blue halos.

name: Atlantic Salmon
funFact: Atlantic salmon can jump waterfalls and dams during their upstream spawning migration.
description: The Atlantic salmon is an anadromous fish born in freshwater, migrates to the ocean, and returns to freshwater to spawn.

name: Chinook Salmon
funFact: Chinook salmon are the largest of all Pacific salmon species.
description: The Chinook salmon, also called king salmon, is the largest Pacific salmon with a greenish back and dark spots.

name: Coho Salmon
funFact: Coho salmon turn bright red with hooked jaws during spawning season.
description: The coho salmon, also known as silver salmon, has a silver body with black spots and is found throughout the North Pacific.

name: Pacific Bluefin Tuna
funFact: Pacific bluefin tuna can cross the entire Pacific Ocean in less than 60 days.
description: The Pacific bluefin tuna is a large, fast, pelagic fish found throughout the Pacific Ocean, highly prized in sushi markets.

name: Yellowfin Tuna
funFact: Yellowfin tuna can swim at speeds up to 40 miles per hour in short bursts.
description: The yellowfin tuna is a large, streamlined ocean fish with bright yellow dorsal and anal fins found in tropical oceans worldwide.

name: Atlantic Cod
funFact: Atlantic cod can detect their prey using electroreception even in murky water.
description: The Atlantic cod is a large, cold-water fish with a distinctive chin barbel and three dorsal fins, once one of the most important food fish in the world.

name: Atlantic Grouper
habitat: Tropical coral reefs and rocky areas
funFact: Groupers can inhale prey whole by suddenly opening their massive mouths.
description: The Atlantic grouper is a large, robust reef fish with a wide mouth and thick lips found in warm Atlantic waters.

name: Goliath Grouper
funFact: Goliath groupers are so large they can weigh as much as a small car.
description: The goliath grouper is the largest bony fish in the Western Atlantic, reaching weights of up to 800 pounds.

name: Red Snapper
funFact: Red snappers can live over 50 years, making them one of the longest-lived snapper species.
description: The red snapper is a bright red reef fish found in the Gulf of Mexico and western Atlantic.
region: Gulf of Mexico and Western Atlantic

name: Barracuda
funFact: Barracudas can swim at speeds over 30 miles per hour in short bursts.
description: The barracuda is a large, predatory fish with a long, streamlined body and razor-sharp teeth found in tropical oceans.

name: Mahi-Mahi
funFact: Mahi-mahi are also called dorado or dolphinfish, not to be confused with dolphins.
description: The mahi-mahi is a brightly colored pelagic fish with a golden-green body and blue fins found in tropical oceans.

name: Wahoo
funFact: Wahoo are among the fastest fish in the ocean, capable of reaching speeds up to 50 mph.
description: The wahoo is a large, fast pelagic fish related to mackerels with a sleek, torpedo-shaped body and vertical blue bars.

name: Sailfish
funFact: Sailfish are considered the fastest fish in the ocean, reaching speeds up to 68 mph.
description: The sailfish is a large billfish with a spectacular high dorsal fin resembling a sail, found in tropical oceans worldwide.

name: Blue Marlin
funFact: Blue marlin can weigh over 1,000 pounds and are among the largest bony fish in the world.
description: The blue marlin is one of the largest ocean fish with a distinctive blue upper body and silver-white belly found in tropical Atlantic waters.

name: Nassau Grouper
funFact: Nassau grouper can change color in seconds to match their surroundings.
description: The Nassau grouper is a large reef fish capable of rapid color changes, now critically endangered from overfishing.

name: Striped Bass
funFact: Striped bass are anadromous and can travel hundreds of miles to spawn.
description: The striped bass is a silver fish with distinctive horizontal dark stripes found along the Atlantic coast.

name: Red Drum
funFact: Red drum are also called channel bass and are the official state fish of North Carolina.
description: The red drum, also called redfish, is a copper-bronze fish with a distinctive black spot near the tail.
region: Western Atlantic and Gulf of Mexico

name: Black Drum
funFact: Black drum can produce loud drumming sounds using muscles on their swim bladder.
description: The black drum is a large, dark fish with barbels on its chin that can grow to over 100 pounds.

name: Channel Catfish
funFact: Channel catfish have taste buds covering their entire body and can taste food from far away.
description: The channel catfish is the most fished catfish species in North America with a forked tail and whisker-like barbels.

name: Blue Catfish
funFact: Blue catfish can grow over 100 pounds and are the largest freshwater fish in North America.
description: The blue catfish is the largest species of North American catfish reaching weights of over 100 pounds.

name: Walking Catfish
funFact: Walking catfish can survive out of water for hours and use their pectoral fins to walk on land.
description: The walking catfish is a freshwater catfish native to Southeast Asia that can breathe air and move across land.

name: Wels Catfish
funFact: Wels catfish have been reported to grow over 16 feet long in rare cases.
description: The wels catfish is the largest freshwater fish in Europe reaching lengths of over 16 feet with a wide, flat head.

name: Eurasian Pike
funFact: Eurasian pike can accelerate from a standstill to 20 mph in less than a tenth of a second.
description: The Eurasian pike is a large, ambush predator found throughout Europe, Asia, and northern North America.

name: Muskellunge
funFact: Muskellunge are also called muskies and are the largest member of the pike family.
description: The muskellunge, or muskie, is the largest freshwater fish in the pike family found in clear lakes and rivers of North America.

name: Walleye
funFact: Walleye have a light-reflecting layer called the tapetum lucidum that makes their eyes glow at night.
description: The walleye is a freshwater fish named for its distinctive, glassy eyes that reflect light found in cool, clear lakes.

name: Common Carp
funFact: Common carp are considered one of the most influential invasive fish species in the world.
description: The common carp is a large, golden-brown freshwater fish found throughout the world, originally from Eurasia.

name: Grass Carp
funFact: Grass carp can eat up to 40% of their body weight in vegetation each day.
description: The grass carp is a large freshwater fish native to eastern Asia that feeds almost exclusively on aquatic plants.

name: Koi
funFact: The most expensive koi ever sold was a Japanese fish named S Legend that sold for $1.8 million.
description: Koi are ornamental varieties of common carp bred for their vibrant colors and patterns from Japan.

name: Goldfish
funFact: Goldfish can recognize their owners and can be trained to push levers for food.
description: The goldfish is one of the most popular aquarium fish in the world, domesticated from East Asia over 1,000 years ago.

name: Tench
funFact: Tench secrete a mucus that can heal wounds in other fish.
description: The tench is a freshwater fish with a thick, slimy body and olive-green to bronze coloration found throughout Europe and Asia.

name: Three-spined Stickleback
habitat: Freshwater streams, ponds, and coastal waters
funFact: Male sticklebacks build elaborate nests from water plants and fan the eggs to provide oxygen.
description: The three-spined stickleback is a small, spiny fish found throughout the Northern Hemisphere, males build intricate nests.

name: Florida Gar
funFact: Florida gar have an elongated snout filled with needle-like teeth and can breathe air.
description: The Florida gar is a long, slender predatory fish with an elongated snout and armored scales found in Florida and Georgia.

name: Alligator Gar
funFact: Alligator gar eggs are toxic to humans but consumed by Native Americans after processing.
description: The alligator gar is the largest freshwater fish in North America, reaching over 8 feet long with a long, alligator-like snout.

name: Bowfin
funFact: Bowfin are the only surviving member of an ancient order of fish.
description: The bowfin is a primitive freshwater fish with an elongated body and a distinctive long dorsal fin found in eastern North America.

name: Chinese Sturgeon
funFact: Chinese sturgeon have existed for over 140 million years and are called living fossils.
description: The Chinese sturgeon is a critically endangered species found only in the Yangtze River that can grow to over 16 feet.

name: Atlantic Sturgeon
funFact: Atlantic sturgeon can live over 100 years and were once hunted for their caviar.
description: The Atlantic sturgeon is a large, primitive fish with a prehistoric appearance featuring bony plates instead of scales.

name: Arctic Char
funFact: Arctic char are the most northerly freshwater fish in the world.
description: The Arctic char is a cold-water fish related to salmon and trout found in Arctic and subarctic waters.

name: Lake Trout
funFact: Lake trout can live over 40 years and grow to over 60 pounds.
description: The lake trout is a large, cold-water salmonid found in deep lakes of northern North America with a forked tail.

name: Cutthroat Trout
funFact: Cutthroat trout are named for the distinctive red slash under their jaw.
description: The cutthroat trout is a cold-water fish native to western North America, named for red-orange slash marks under its lower jaw.

name: Golden Trout
funFact: Golden trout are the official state fish of California and are found only in a few remote streams.
description: The golden trout is a subspecies of rainbow trout found in high-altitude mountain streams of California with golden-yellow body.

name: Tiger Shark
funFact: Tiger sharks are known as the garbage cans of the sea because they eat almost anything.
description: The tiger shark is a large predator with distinctive dark vertical stripes found in tropical and subtropical oceans worldwide.

name: Bull Shark
habitat: Warm shallow coastal waters and rivers
funFact: Bull sharks are one of the few shark species that can survive in freshwater rivers.
description: The bull shark is a large, stocky shark found in warm, shallow coastal waters and occasionally in freshwater rivers.

name: Oceanic Whitetip Shark
funFact: Oceanic whitetip sharks were responsible for more human casualties than any other species during World War II.
description: The oceanic whitetip shark is a large, slow-moving pelagic shark with distinctive white-tipped fins, critically endangered.

name: Blacktip Shark
funFact: Blacktip sharks are known for their dramatic breaching behavior, spinning out of the water.
description: The blacktip shark is a medium-sized shark with distinctive black tips on all its fins found in warm coastal waters.

name: Hammerhead Shark
funFact: Hammerhead sharks have 360-degree vision thanks to their wide-set eyes.
description: The hammerhead shark is a distinctive shark with a wide, flattened head that gives it a hammer-like appearance found in warm waters.

name: Scalloped Hammerhead
funFact: Scalloped hammerheads form massive schools of hundreds during their annual migration.
description: The scalloped hammerhead is one of the most common hammerhead species with a distinctive scalloped leading edge on its head.

name: Thresher Shark
habitat: Open ocean tropical and temperate waters
funFact: Thresher sharks use their extremely long tail whip to stun schools of fish.
description: The thresher shark is a distinctive shark with an extremely long upper tail that can be as long as its body found in open ocean.

name: Basking Shark
funFact: Basking sharks are the second largest fish in the world, after whale sharks.
description: The basking shark is the second largest fish in the world, filter-feeding on plankton with an enormous mouth over 3 feet wide.

name: Whale Shark
funFact: Whale sharks have over 3,000 tiny teeth arranged in 500 rows, but they don't use them for feeding.
description: The whale shark is the largest fish in the world, reaching over 40 feet, a gentle filter feeder found in tropical oceans.

name: Nurse Shark
habitat: Tropical and warm temperate coastal waters
funFact: Nurse sharks can pump water over their gills while resting on the ocean floor.
description: The nurse shark is a sluggish, bottom-dwelling shark with barbels near its nostrils that help detect prey hidden in sand.

name: Zebra Shark
funFact: Zebra sharks change from striped as juveniles to spotted as adults.
description: The zebra shark is a distinctive shark with dark spots on a tan body found on tropical coral reefs of the Indo-Pacific.

name: Epaulette Shark
funFact: Epaulette sharks can walk on their fins across the reef flat at low tide.
description: The epaulette shark is a small reef shark that can walk on its fins across the reef flat found in the Indo-Pacific.

name: Angel Shark
funFact: Angel sharks can bury themselves completely in sand to ambush passing prey.
description: The angel shark is a flattened shark that lies buried in sand on the ocean floor, critically endangered due to habitat loss.

name: Manta Ray
funFact: Manta rays have the largest brain-to-body ratio of any fish and can recognize themselves in mirrors.
description: The manta ray is one of the largest rays in the world with a wingspan that can exceed 20 feet, a gentle filter feeder.

name: Southern Stingray
habitat: Shallow tropical and subtropical ocean floors
funFact: Southern stingrays can deliver a venomous barb sting that can cause severe pain.
description: The southern stingray is a large, diamond-shaped ray found in shallow tropical waters of the western Atlantic.

name: Cownose Ray
funFact: Cownose rays migrate in massive schools of thousands along the Atlantic coast.
description: The cownose ray is a distinctive ray with a unique head shape resembling a cow's nose, forming large schools during migration.

name: Spotted Eagle Ray
funFact: Spotted eagle rays can leap several feet out of the water.
description: The spotted eagle ray is a large ray with distinctive white spots on a dark body found in tropical and subtropical oceans.

name: Atlantic Anglerfish
funFact: Male anglerfish fuse permanently to females and share their bloodstream.
description: The Atlantic anglerfish is a deep-sea fish with a distinctive bioluminescent lure that attracts prey found on the deep ocean floor.

name: Viperfish
funFact: Viperfish have extremely long, needle-like teeth that are so long they don't fit inside their mouths.
description: The viperfish is a deep-sea predator with extremely long, needle-like teeth and a bioluminescent photophore along its body.

name: Gulper Eel
funFact: Gulper eels have enormous mouths that can open wide enough to swallow prey larger than themselves.
description: The gulper eel is a deep-sea fish with an enormous, loosely hinged mouth and a long, whip-like tail found in deep ocean waters.

name: Great White Shark
habitat: Coastal and open ocean temperate waters
funFact: Great white sharks can detect a single drop of blood in 25 gallons of water.
description: The great white shark is the world's largest known predatory fish, an apex predator found in coastal and offshore waters worldwide.

name: Seahorse
habitat: Shallow tropical and temperate coastal waters
funFact: Male seahorses are the only male animals that become pregnant and give birth.
description: The seahorse is a small marine fish with a horse-like head, prehensile tail, and upright swimming posture found in shallow coastal waters worldwide.

name: Pufferfish
funFact: Pufferfish contain tetrodotoxin, a poison 1,200 times more deadly than cyanide.
description: The pufferfish is a marine fish capable of inflating its body to several times its normal size as a defense mechanism, found in tropical and subtropical waters.

name: Lungfish
funFact: Lungfish can breathe air and survive out of water for months by burrowing into mud.
description: The lungfish is a freshwater fish with both gills and primitive lungs, one of the closest living relatives to tetrapods found in Africa, South America, and Australia.

name: Coelacanth
funFact: Coelacanths were thought to be extinct for 66 million years until rediscovered in 1938.
description: The coelacanth is a living fossil, a lobe-finned fish once thought extinct that was rediscovered off the coast of South Africa in 1938.

name: Red-bellied Piranha
funFact: Red-bellied piranhas can strip a carcass to bone in minutes with their razor-sharp teeth.
description: The red-bellied piranha is a freshwater fish native to South America known for its sharp teeth and powerful jaws found in rivers and lakes.

name: Arapaima
funFact: Arapaima are among the largest freshwater fish in the world and can breathe air.
description: The arapaima is one of the largest freshwater fish in the world, reaching lengths of over 10 feet, found in the Amazon basin.

name: Piranha
funFact: Piranhas have been known to bite humans but attacks are extremely rare in the wild.
description: The piranha is a freshwater fish native to South American rivers known for its sharp teeth and powerful jaws found in tropical and subtropical waters.

name: Arowana
funFact: Arowana can jump up to 6 feet out of the water to catch prey on overhanging branches.
description: The arowana is a freshwater fish with large, metallic scales and an upward-pointing mouth found in tropical rivers of South America, Asia, and Australia.

name: Electric Eel
funFact: Electric eels can generate shocks of up to 860 volts, enough to stun a horse.
description: The electric eel is a freshwater fish capable of generating powerful electric shocks used for hunting and self-defense found in South American rivers.

name: Black Ghost Knifefish
funFact: Black ghost knifefish use weak electric fields to navigate and find prey in dark, murky water.
description: The black ghost knifefish is a freshwater fish with an elongated, laterally compressed body and a distinctive anal fin used for propulsion.

name: Betta
habitat: Freshwater rice paddies and slow streams
funFact: Male bettas build bubble nests at the water surface for their eggs.
description: The betta, or Siamese fighting fish, is a small freshwater fish with flowing fins and vibrant colors native to Southeast Asia.

name: Discus
funFact: Discus parents produce a mucus secretion that their young feed on for the first few weeks.
description: The discus is a freshwater fish with a distinctive disc-shaped body found in the Amazon basin, popular in aquariums for its vibrant colors.

name: Oscar
funFact: Oscars are highly intelligent fish that can recognize their owners.
description: The oscar is a large cichlid native to South America with a dark body and orange-red markings, popular in aquariums for its personality.

name: Freshwater Angelfish
funFact: Freshwater angelfish are actually cichlids, not related to marine angelfish.
description: The freshwater angelfish is a popular aquarium fish with a distinctive triangular body shape and long, flowing fins native to the Amazon basin.

name: Convict Cichlid
funFact: Convict cichlids are devoted parents that aggressively defend their young.
description: The convict cichlid is a small freshwater fish with distinctive black vertical stripes on a light body found in Central America.

name: Peacock Cichlid
funFact: Male peacock cichlids display brilliant blue, red, and gold colors during breeding.
description: The peacock cichlid is a colorful freshwater fish found in Lake Malawi with males displaying vibrant blues, reds, and golds.

name: Lionfish
funFact: Lionfish venomous spines can cause extreme pain and their venom is heat-stable.
description: The lionfish is a venomous marine fish with distinctive red, white, and brown stripes and fan-like pectoral fins found in tropical reefs.

name: Stonefish
habitat: Tropical coral reefs and rocky areas
funFact: Stonefish are the most venomous fish in the world, their sting can be fatal to humans.
description: The stonefish is the most venomous fish in the world, masters of camouflage resembling rocks on the ocean floor found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

name: Leafy Seadragon
funFact: Leafy seadragons have no stomach or teeth and must eat almost constantly.
description: The leafy seadragon is a marine fish related to seahorses with leaf-like appendages providing perfect camouflage in kelp forests.

name: Weedy Seadragon
funFact: Weedy seadragons carry their eggs on the male's tail until they hatch.
description: The weedy seadragon is a marine fish related to seahorses with small leaf-like appendages found in kelp forests of southern Australia.

name: Yellow Boxfish
funFact: Boxfish can release a toxin when stressed that can kill other fish in an aquarium.
description: The yellow boxfish is a small, cube-shaped reef fish with bright yellow coloration and black spots found in the Indo-Pacific.

name: Longhorn Cowfish
funFact: Longhorn cowfish have two horn-like spines protruding from their head.
description: The longhorn cowfish is a distinctive reef fish with horn-like spines on its head and a boxy, armored body found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

name: Spotted Trunkfish
funFact: Trunkfish can squirt a toxic substance from their skin when threatened.
description: The spotted trunkfish is a small, box-shaped reef fish with white spots on a dark body found in Caribbean coral reefs.

name: Scrawled Filefish
habitat: Tropical coral reefs and seagrass beds
funFact: Filefish can change color and pattern to match their surroundings.
description: The scrawled filefish is a marine fish with a distinctive elongated body and blue spots found in tropical Atlantic waters.

name: Queen Triggerfish
funFact: Triggerfish have a spine on their dorsal fin that can be locked in an upright position.
description: The queen triggerfish is a large, colorful reef fish with distinctive blue lines on its face and a trigger spine on its dorsal fin.

name: Slender Leatherjacket
funFact: Leatherjackets have rough, sandpaper-like skin used by early settlers as sandpaper.
description: The slender leatherjacket is a small marine fish with a compressed body and rough skin found in coastal waters worldwide.

name: Stoplight Parrotfish
funFact: Parrotfish excrete digested coral as fine white sand, creating tropical beaches.
description: The stoplight parrotfish is a colorful reef fish with a beak-like mouth used to scrape algae from coral found in Caribbean reefs.

name: Cleaner Wrasse
funFact: Cleaner wrasses set up cleaning stations where larger fish line up to have parasites removed.
description: The cleaner wrasse is a small reef fish with a distinctive blue stripe that sets up cleaning stations to remove parasites from larger fish.

name: Ornate Tuskfish
funFact: Tuskfish use rocks as anvils to crack open shellfish for food.
description: The ornate tuskfish is a colorful reef fish with distinctive blue and orange markings found in the Indo-Pacific.

name: Marbled Grouper
funFact: Marbled groupers form massive spawning aggregations of thousands of individuals.
description: The marbled grouper is a large reef fish with a marbled pattern found in tropical Indo-Pacific coral reefs.

name: Humphead Wrasse
funFact: Humphead wrasses can live over 30 years and are the largest living labrid fish.
description: The humphead wrasse is the largest living wrasse species with a distinctive hump on its forehead found in Indo-Pacific coral reefs.

name: Coral Grouper
funFact: Coral groupers hunt cooperatively with moray eels, using head shakes to signal the eel to flush out prey.
description: The coral grouper is a large reef fish with a reddish body and blue spots found in tropical Indo-Pacific coral reefs.

name: Banggai Cardinalfish
funFact: Male Banggai cardinalfish mouthbrood the eggs until they hatch.
description: The Banggai cardinalfish is a small, striking reef fish with black and white stripes and long fins found only in the Banggai Islands of Indonesia.

name: Garibaldi Damselfish
habitat: Tropical coral reefs and kelp forests
funFact: Male garibaldi build and tend elaborate nests of algae to attract mates.
description: The garibaldi is a bright orange damselfish found in kelp forests of the eastern Pacific, the official marine fish of California.

name: Sergeant Major
funFact: Male sergeant majors turn dark purple when guarding their eggs.
description: The sergeant major is a small reef fish with five black vertical bars on a light body found in tropical Atlantic waters.

name: Neon Goby
funFact: Neon gobies set up cleaning stations and remove parasites from larger fish.
description: The neon goby is a tiny reef fish with a bright blue stripe that sets up cleaning stations to remove parasites from larger fish.

name: Midas Blenny
funFact: Midas blennies often join schools of cleaner wrasses to avoid predation.
description: The Midas blenny is a small, golden-yellow reef fish that mimics cleaner wrasses for protection found in Indo-Pacific coral reefs.

name: Tasseled Scorpionfish
funFact: Scorpionfish are masters of camouflage, resembling algae-covered rocks on the reef.
description: The tasseled scorpionfish is a venomous reef fish with elaborate skin flaps providing excellent camouflage found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

name: Bartail Flathead
funFact: Flathead are ambush predators that bury themselves in sand to surprise prey.
description: The bartail flathead is a bottom-dwelling marine fish with a flattened head and body found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

name: Blue-striped Grunt
funFact: Grunts get their name from the sound they make by grinding their teeth.
description: The blue-striped grunt is a small reef fish with distinctive blue horizontal stripes found in Caribbean coral reefs.

name: Clown Tang
funFact: Clown tangs are extremely territorial and can be aggressive toward other fish.
description: The clown tang is a bright blue surgeonfish with white and black markings found in coral reefs of the Indo-Pacific.

name: Squirrelfish
funFact: Squirrelfish have large eyes adapted for nocturnal hunting.
description: The squirrelfish is a small, red reef fish with large eyes found in tropical coral reefs worldwide, active at night.

name: Sweep
funFact: Sweep are named for their distinctive sweeping swimming motion.
description: The sweep is a small, silvery fish with a distinctive deep body found in temperate rocky reefs of the Indo-Pacific.

name: New Zealand Magpie
funFact: New Zealand magpie are freshwater leatherjackets found only in New Zealand.
description: The New Zealand magpie is a small freshwater fish with a compressed body and rough skin found in rivers and lakes of New Zealand.

name: John Dory
funFact: John Dory have a distinctive dark spot on each side that looks like a thumbprint.
description: The John Dory is a marine fish with a distinctive oval body and dark lateral spot found in temperate coastal waters of the Indo-Pacific.

name: Longsnout Boarfish
funFact: Boarfish use their elongated snout to extract small invertebrates from coral crevices.
description: The longsnout boarfish is a distinctive reef fish with a long, tubular snout and black and white stripes found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.

name: Bigeye
funFact: Bigeyes have extremely large eyes adapted for nocturnal feeding.
description: The bigeye is a small reef fish with disproportionately large eyes found in tropical coral reefs worldwide, active at night.

name: Blackbar Soldierfish
funFact: Soldierfish are nocturnal and hide in reef crevices during the day.
description: The blackbar soldierfish is a small, red reef fish with a distinctive black bar behind its gill cover found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters.
